Sally Yeh Promotional Portrait

Sally Yeh appears in a sleek white blazer, styled with multiple silver chains and a striking black pendant. Her hair is casually swept up, and her makeup is natural yet polished, emphasizing her poised expression. The plain backdrop focuses attention on her fashion choices and confident stance.

This portrait was published alongside a November 2022 interview in which Yeh recalls her early career in Hong Kong’s vibrant 1980s music scene.
